description: Prompt corpus for the functional test plan (docs/design/v1/layerwise/functional-test-plan.md, section 2). Each prompt is a registry of records followed by a question about a record in the first chunk, so KV loaded into the wrong place gives a wrong answer rather than drift. Lengths are exact token counts for the target model's tokenizer; functional/harness/build_corpus.py builds the prompts from this spec.

P-short.why: Nothing cacheable; must never touch L2

P-short-v2.why: Nothing cacheable even after decode: prompt + max_tokens stays under one chunk (lengths at most chunk_size - max_tokens = 208), so neither prompt nor generated tokens complete a chunk and nothing is stored; must never touch L2. Replaces P-short for T-E2E-01

P-exact.why: Chunk-boundary off-by-one: exactly 1, 2, 4 and max (pipelined_max_chunks) chunks

P-ragged.why: Partial last chunk is not stored; a hit covers only full chunks

P-long.why: The pipelined_max_chunks cap, and the refusal just past it

P-shared.why: Prefix reuse across requests: one long shared system prompt, different tails

P-multi.why: Growing prefix: 10 scripted 5-turn conversations; each turn adds records and asks about one from turn 1

P-salt.why: Tenant isolation: P-shared sent under two cache_salt values
